questions.prompt: The Suez Canal opened in which decade?
questions.fact: Verdi was commissioned to write an opera for the occasion, though Aida arrived two years after the opening.

questions.prompt: Which scientist formulated the three laws of motion?
questions.fact: He served as Master of the Mint and pursued counterfeiters personally, securing several executions.

questions.prompt: How many events make up a men's decathlon?
questions.fact: They are contested over two days, and the scoring tables are designed so no single event can dominate the total.

questions.prompt: Which video game features a plumber named Mario?
questions.fact: He first appeared as a carpenter in Donkey Kong, and was renamed after the landlord of the company's American warehouse.

questions.prompt: Which is the only continent that lies in all four hemispheres?
questions.fact: The equator and the prime meridian both cross it, which is what places parts of it in every quadrant.

questions.prompt: Which playwright wrote 'Death of a Salesman'?
questions.fact: He wrote the first act in roughly a day and a half, in a shed he had built himself for the purpose.
